free_tier.stated: Uploading and downloading are 100% free; free or non-account files are kept 20 days and each file must be under 10 GB.

per_object_cap.stated: 10 GB per file for free or non-account uploads and for premium

retention.stated: 20 days for free or non-account files and for premium files

egress.terms: Premium: $4.99 for 1 month, $13.99 for 3 months, $49.99 for the longest period listed; benefits are direct downloads with no waiting and no advertising. No free download volume is published.

interface_detail: Web upload and an API page linked from the footer; the API was not read.
tooling: Browser upload; the footer links an API page that was not read.
chaining: Premium does not extend retention: both tiers keep files 20 days, so the paid tier buys speed and no waiting, not storage time.

limits.value: 10 GB per file on both free and premium
files are kept 20 days on both free and premium

binding_note: Files are removed after 20 days on every tier, so nothing stored here outlasts a month.

identity_cost.detail: The FAQ states limits for free or non-account uploads, and the home page has a no-registration upload route. Premium is a paid account.

reliability_note: The vendor pages answered HTTP 403 to the page reader while still returning their full content.
confidence_note: FAQ and upgrade page read through a page reader that received HTTP 403 with the page body. The registration form fields are unread.

evidence.quote: Each file you upload must be less than 10 GB in size for free/non accounts or less than 10 GB in size for premium accounts.
evidence.proved: the cap is 10 GB per file on free and on premium

evidence.quote: Free/non accounts files are kept for 20 days. Premium accounts files are kept for 20 days.
evidence.proved: retention is 20 days on both tiers

notes: Cheapest paid tier is the $4.99 one-month premium.
